mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 48 degrees with clear skies observed near the Verona Area High School, and the moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to recognize the hard work of our planning department. Also, the city is partnering with local firms to conduct important cross connection control surveys to keep our water supply safe.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. The Dane County Farmers Market is happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the World Dairy Expo or take the family to the Farley Center Fall Festival for some apple cider pressing.
Regarding local activity, on Sunday, September 21, a two-vehicle crash with injuries occurred, and a driver was cited for operating too fast for roadway conditions.
Today's flavor is the delicious Really Reese's, and please note the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
